SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(ACID)), 'BUSC' FROM busc.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE
UNION ALL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(A.ACID)), 'BUSC-Joined-GAM' FROM busc.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE A
    LEFT JOIN busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER B ON B.ACID = A.ACID AND B.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
UNION ALL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(B.FORACID)), 'BUSC-Joined-GAM-FORACID' FROM busc.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE A
    LEFT JOIN busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER B ON B.ACID = A.ACID AND B.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
UNION ALL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(B.FORACID)), 'BUSC-Joined-GAM-FORACID-Exclude-Dummy' FROM busc.DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE A
    LEFT JOIN busc.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER B ON B.ACID = A.ACID AND B.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
    WHERE SCHM_CODE NOT LIKE '09%'
UNION ALL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(CustomerAccountId)), 'BNKM' FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance WHERE PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date' AND SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
UNION ALL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(A.CustomerAccountId)), 'BNKM-Joined' FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance A
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP') B ON B.CustomerAccountId = A.CustomerAccountId AND B.FinancialInstitutionId = A.FinancialInstitutionId
    WHERE A.PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date' AND A.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
UNION ALL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(A.CustomerAccountId)), 'BNKM-Joined-Exclude-Dummy' FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance A
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP') B ON B.CustomerAccountId = A.CustomerAccountId AND B.FinancialInstitutionId = A.FinancialInstitutionId
    WHERE A.PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date' AND A.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' AND B.ProductId NOT LIKE '09%'
UNION ALL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(AccountID)), 'DW' FROM dw.FactDepositSOutstandingBalance
ORDER BY 2
